It is also certain that this is the correct equivalence relation since an inner product is the essential ingredient for a Hilbert space and isomorphic Hilbert spaces have the “same"inner product. One might object that completeness is another essential ingredient in the definition of a Hilbert space. So it is! However, this too is preserved by an isomorphism.
